facts.fact: A fresh passport application cannot be submitted directly at a Passport Office
facts.quote: No, you cannot apply for a Passport at a Passport Office. You need to visit Passport Seva Kendra/ Post Office Passport Seva Kendra to submit your Passport application.
facts.note: Quoted from the Passport Seva portal's own content file, which the FAQ page loads; the FAQ answers sit in collapsed accordions, so the page's visible text does not show them. (https://www.passportindia.gov.in/psp/FaqWhereToApply)

facts.fact: The application is submitted at a Passport Seva Kendra (PSK) or Post Office Passport Seva Kendra (POPSK)
facts.quote: You need to visit Passport Seva Kendra/ Post Office Passport Seva Kendra to submit your Passport application.
facts.note: Quoted from the Passport Seva portal's own content file, which the FAQ page loads; the FAQ answers sit in collapsed accordions, so the page's visible text does not show them. (https://www.passportindia.gov.in/psp/FaqWhereToApply)

summary: Passport Seva FAQ still says fresh applications go to a PSK/POPSK, not the Passport Office.
